title: CALIFORNIA BANCORP ANNOUNCES RETIREMENT OF CEO STEVEN SHELTON AND APPOINTMENT OF DAVID RAINER AS CEO
summary: San Diego, Calif., Jan. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - California BanCorp (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: BCAL), the holding company for California Bank of Commerce, N.A. (the “Bank”), announces that Steven Shelton has retired from the position of Chief Executive Officer and Director of the Company and the Bank, effective as of December 31, 2025. Mr. Shelton will continue to work with the Company and Bank through December 31, 2026, in an advisory capacity.
